This [[Chest of the Slaver (Selvetarm)]] will spawn after defeating [[Selvetarm]] in the [[Slavers' Exile]] dungeon. Each player in the party can open the chest and will receive one item from the drop list in [[normal mode]] and two in [[hard mode]]. 

==Locations==

[[Depths of Tyria]]
*[[Slavers' Exile]]
**Selvetarm's Level

==Drops==
===[[Rare crafting material]]s===
*[[Diamond]]
*[[Onyx Gemstone]]

===Others===
*Random [[Item rarity|rare]] items including, but not limited to: 
**[[Storm Bow]]
**[[Voltaic Spear]]

==Notes==
*Unlike other [[Dungeon Chest]]s, no countdown-timer will appear once every [[Party|Party Member]] has opened the Chest. This allows players to exit the current level back to the Slavers' Exile staging area.
